generator.notes: The generator and its dependencies are not copied into MVForge. The PNGs are locally authored Pillow images.

png.font: Verdana for French; AppleSDGothicNeo for Korean, locally installed fonts used only at fixture authoring time

pgs.independentProbe: ffprobe recognized both raw SUP streams as hdmv_pgs_subtitle 1280x720 and reported PTS at 1.0, 2.5, 3.0, and 4.5 seconds

mkv.muxCommand: ffmpeg -copyts -f lavfi -i color=c=black:s=1280x720:r=25:d=6 -i french.sup -i korean.sup -map 0:v:0 -map 1:s:0 -map 2:s:0 -c:v ffv1 -c:s copy -metadata:s:s:0 language=fra -metadata:s:s:0 title=synthetic-french -metadata:s:s:1 language=kor -metadata:s:s:1 title=synthetic-korean -shortest two-bitmap-tracks.mkv
mkv.timestampHandling: Use FFmpeg -copyts during mux; ffprobe confirmed the MKV and backend-extracted SUP retain starts at 1.0 and 3.0 seconds. Without -copyts the mux shifted starts to 0.0 and 2.0 seconds.
